description: Vue 3 + Vite SPA, obfuscated automatically via @afterpack/vue (the thin wrapper over @afterpack/vite). Proves a Vue single-file-component build survives obfuscation: renders + the reactive counter interaction works in chromium.

build.note: obfuscation runs automatically via @afterpack/vue's closeBundle hook (vite.config.ts) -- no separate step

interactions.description: Reactive counter increments and re-renders on click.
